proposals.title: Close TASK-0006 review-03: two MAJOR findings in CanonicalEncoder
proposals.why_now: TASK-0006 has been rejected in three successive reviews. Review-03 issued exactly two MAJOR findings that are narrowly scoped: (1) capturedParseInt10 in canonical.ts reads Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER and Number.NaN from the live global at call time rather than capturing them at module initialization, violating the no-user-code-execution guarantee; (2) the validation evidence supplied by the Implementer contains no captured output for npm run compile or npm run boundary on the corrected candidate state. Both are mechanical, non-architectural fixes. The CanonicalEncoder must be accepted before StateHash can exist, and StateHash is required for INV-01, INV-22, and the FASE-1 CI gate that replays three reference games and compares StateHash tick by tick. Every other FASE-1 hash-dependent deliverable remains gated on this acceptance. No FASE-1 work can reach the CI replay gate without it.

proposals.title: Branded numeric types and division helper in packages/core (ADR-003 + ADR-004)
proposals.why_now: Every subsequent FASE-1 deliverable — ledger entries, price queries, order execution, RNG coordinates, and the tick loop — uses the primitive vocabulary defined by ADR-003 and ADR-004. Without Money, Quantity, Price, Rate as bigint nominal wrappers and Tick as a safe-integer nominal wrapper, implementing any of those subsystems means retrofitting types and lint enforcement across all arithmetic code later. ADR-004 requires that every division declares a rounding mode; establishing the division helper and the lint or compiler mechanism that enforces mode declaration now prevents undetected precision loss from accumulating across future domain code. This work is independent of the CanonicalEncoder and can proceed while IDEA-001 is in review.

proposals.title: Positional RNG with ADR specifying hash primitive bit-by-bit (ADR-002)
proposals.why_now: The price generator, macro event scheduler, bot policy derivation, NPC tip truth values, and venue liquidity all consume rand(masterSeed, namespace, ...coordinates). None of them can be implemented with correct determinism guarantees until the hash primitive is specified bit-by-bit in an ADR and the pure rand() function exists in packages/core. ADR-002 marks the hash function as DEFINIR with a recommendation of SplitMix64 over an FNV-1a accumulator; the ADR must be written and the implementation must follow it exactly. INV-02 requires that querying price(asset, t) directly equals arriving at t tick by tick — the only way to verify this is to have the RNG available for testing. This work is independent of CanonicalEncoder and of the branded types, though pairing it with IDEA-002 delivers a complete core package faster.

proposals.title: Minimum Electron scaffold with installer and simulation worker (FASE-1 installer criterion)
proposals.why_now: FASE-1 acceptance explicitly requires an installable artifact for Windows and Linux produced by CI and the simulation already running in a dedicated worker outside the rendering thread with a typed message contract. The spec notes that discovering packaging problems late (module native recompilation, ABI mismatches, file-path issues) is the main source of irrecoverable late-stage failures — a window that opens but shows little is more valuable than a perfect installer in FASE-7. The apps/desktop scaffold already exists as empty stubs. Wiring the security configuration required by INV-29 (contextIsolation, nodeIntegration off, sandbox on, minimal contextBridge allowlist) is part of this work and must be correct from the start; retrofitting it later breaks preload contracts. This deliverable is independent of all core domain code.

proposals.title: Multi-commodity double-entry ledger foundation in packages/domain
proposals.why_now: The ledger is the single invariant anchor of the entire economic simulation: INV-04 (every transaction balances per commodity), INV-05 (BRL sum is always zero), INV-06 (each asset quantity sum is always zero), and INV-07 (no rounding residue is lost) all require the ledger to exist before they can be tested or enforced. No order execution, no position tracking, no margining, and no tick processing can be implemented without a working ledger. The ledger has no dependency on the price generator, the RNG, or the CanonicalEncoder — it depends only on the branded numeric types from IDEA-002. Implementing it as soon as branded types are accepted eliminates the longest blocking chain for order execution and the tick loop, which are the core of the FASE-1 demo.
